purpose: Falsify whether independent subtalker temperature 0.9 resolves the original seed-196 no-EOS trajectory; no production change or quality promotion
text: 持续验证语音服务的稳定性和恢复能力。
baseline_parity: Both seed-196 baseline outputs must match the original production-SDK tokens and PCM SHA exactly
stop_rule: Retain all six cases regardless of EOS; stop only for baseline mismatch, invalid audio, process error or resource/time bound
next_gate: If both candidate repetitions terminate, predeclare a broader paired text/voice/seed cohort and transcribe every output. Otherwise reject this hypothesis; never rerun unchanged cases to select success.
promotion: No production parameter change without the fixed corpus and interface/lifecycle regression, original strict target gate and human listening evidence
